Class ModelLessons

java.lang.Object
guiLessons.ModelLessons
public class ModelLessons extends Object

Title: ModelLessons Class.

Description: Provides lesson validation and database operations for the lesson page. Maintains an in-memory lesson list that is replaced when all lessons are read. The controller validates lessons before calling create or update; those persistence methods do not perform validation themselves. Database operations require the application's database connection to be open and propagate SQL errors to the caller.

Author:
Ahmad El-Merhaby

  • Method Details

    • validateLesson

      protected static String validateLesson(entityClasses.Lesson lesson)
      Checks the lesson's text lengths in title, problem, solution, and experience order. The Lesson constructor trims text and converts null text values to empty strings before this validation.
      Parameters:
      lesson - the non-null lesson to validate
      Returns:
      the first validation error, or an empty string when the title contains 1-100 characters, problem and solution each contain 1-2000 characters, and optional experience contains 0-2000 characters

      protected static boolean updateLesson(entityClasses.Lesson lesson, entityClasses.User actor) throws SQLException

      Parameters:
      lesson - the non-null, validated lesson containing the ID and new values

    • toggleLock

      protected static entityClasses.Lesson toggleLock(int lessonId, ModelLessons.LessonField field, entityClasses.User actor) throws SQLException
      Updates a field lock of an existing lesson. Only admins and curators (eventually) have the ability to lock/unlock lesson fields. Contributors cannot interact with locked fields.
      Parameters:
      lessonId - the ID of the lesson to change
      field - the non-null field for the lesson being changed
      actor - the user actor requesting the change
      Returns:
      the lesson containing the saved lock state
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if the actor is null or unpriviliged
      IllegalStateException - if no matching record exists
      SQLException - if the database fails to read or save the lock

    • setLessonsLocked

      protected static void setLessonsLocked(List<Integer> ids, boolean locked, entityClasses.User actor) throws SQLException
